''See also: [[Estyr Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Estyr is a powerful figure whose identity and status have shifted through various stages, moving from a struggling youth in the high passes known as [[Estyr Fourteen]] to a celebrated savior and hero called [[Estyr Six]]. Her family's prosperity and safety increased significantly after she transitioned to this new status. She possesses immense supernatural abilities, including the capacity for flight and the use of [[Intent]] to manipulate her surroundings. A signature aspect of her power is a halo of spinning Sandborn Hydra{{!}}Hydra skulls that orbit her head. She has been known to wear black armor similar in design to the Emperor's and a helmet with a dark visor. Throughout her long history, which spans centuries of waking and sleeping, she has acted as a protector, a combatant capable of laying waste to her enemies, and a figure of Authority{{!}}authority who commands vessels. Her presence is marked by intense energy that can overwhelm others, and she has been depicted as a ruler or a force of [[destruction]] intended to assert ownership over the world.}}

{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Estyr is a character who spends time observing the sky.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c22">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 22</ref>}}

</ul></div>

{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Regarded in both history and myth as the equal of the Emperor, Estyr serves as a [[Regent]] accompanied by three orbiting skulls.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c2">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c6">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c7">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 7</ref> She demonstrates immense physical resilience by weathering a shoulder-tackle like solid oak and utilizes extremely fast fists in combat.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c6" /><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c7" /> Driven by a desire to reclaim her skulls, she once launched a piece of wood at [[Baldezar Kern]] with the speed of a bullet.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c7" /> During her final battles, she fought using seven spikes to attack and was seen levitating Jorin Curse-breaker{{!}}Jorin and [[Loreli]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 24</ref> After dying from her wounds, she left behind a legacy marked by accusations that [[Calder]] and the speech-writers refused to address directly.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c9">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 9</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c15">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 15</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c23">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 23</ref> A massive bronze statue of Estyr now stands dwarfing the [[Lyathatan]], featuring skulls carved into its crown.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c25">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 25</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Soulbound and Vessels}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Estyr is a [[Soulbound]] woman who possesses three [[Vessels]] and keeps Sandborn Hydra{{!}}Hydra skulls while practicing her art.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c2">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c4">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 6</ref> An individual capable of [[Reading]] the truth, she was intended to lead [[Shera]] and Nathanael Bareius{{!}}Bareius into battle.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6" /> Following a confrontation at the top of the [[Rose Tower]] with two [[Guild Heads]], her mangled and burned body was discovered leaving a hole in the room.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 8</ref> Despite her warped face and scar-ravaged body, a small gray string emitted her powerful and confident [[Intent]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c10">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c11">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c14">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 14</ref> She maintained a journal mentioning the [[Consultants]] and acted as a ruler who prioritized fighting the [[Elders]] over political matters.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c11" /><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c13">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 13</ref> Estyr accused the Steward of Elder worship and claimed that Imperial Steward Calder Marten{{!}}Calder Marten was enthralled by [[Kelarac]] after selling his soul to him.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c14" /> She also made reference to a previous event that the allies of [[Shera]] wish to avoid repeating.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c16">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 16</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Regent of the North}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|As one of the remaining [[Regents]], Estyr possesses a level of talent comparable to [[Loreli]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c18">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 18</ref> This tall, blonde individual is often seen with skulls whirling around her head.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c21">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 21</ref> During discussions, Estyr asserted that there was only one Emperor and proposed a plan to divide the world into four parts.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c21" /> Though she held the potential to collapse the foundations of the Capital, Estyr is the [[Regent]] of the North who has been unable to be restored to her right mind.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 23</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 24</ref> After unearthing a set of jet-black armor that resembled the Emperor's, she arrived to attack with an [[iron spike]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 25</ref> Clad in her black armor, she drove seven [[Blackwatch spikes]] into an Elder.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c26">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 26</ref> While lounging on the edge of a [[stone]] coffin, Estyr used her power to roll the lid over [[Shera]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c27">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 27</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">12</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Estyr]] is a person [[Loreli]] has talent comparable to.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c18" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Estyr]] is tall with blonde hair and skulls whirling around her head.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c21" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Estyr]] stated there was only one Emperor.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c21" />}}</li>
